deskyard computer use: set a server's default computer

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] computer use COMPUTER|SERVER/COMPUTER

Checks that you can see COMPUTER on the default server (or SERVER), then makes
it that server's default computer, used when -c isn't given.

Arguments:
  COMPUTER   string      required  computer name, or SERVER/COMPUTER

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard computer use alice
  deskyard computer use work/bob

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
